rules.title: Django DEBUG enabled
rules.message: DEBUG=True leaks stack traces and settings in production.
rules.fix: Force DEBUG=False in production via environment.

rules.title: Flask debug mode
rules.message: Flask debug/reloader can expose an interactive debugger (RCE risk).

rules.title: Express verbose error handler
rules.message: Sending stack traces to clients aids attackers.
rules.fix: Log stacks server-side; return generic errors to clients.

rules.title: Spring Actuator exposure hint
rules.message: Exposing all actuators can leak env and heap dumps.
rules.fix: Expose only health/info; lock down with auth and network policy.
